facts.label: Average NFIP payout for belongings (contents) after Hurricane Irma (all states)
facts.source: FEMA NFIP claims via Snowflake Public Data
facts.note: Mean AMOUNT_PAID_ON_CONTENTS_CLAIM over 8326 claims with a contents payment > 0; FLOOD_EVENT = 'Hurricane Irma', DATE_OF_LOSS 2017-09-09..2017-09-12, all states. Rounded to whole dollars.

facts.label: Most rain in one day at Miami International Airport during Hurricane Irma
facts.source: NOAA weather station data via Snowflake Public Data
facts.note: Max daily VARIABLE = 'precipitation' in NOAA_WEATHER_METRICS_TIMESERIES at station USW00012839 (MIAMI INTL AP), DATE 2017-09-09..2017-09-12.

facts.label: NFIP flood insurance claims from Hurricane Irma (all states)
facts.source: FEMA NFIP claims via Snowflake Public Data
facts.note: FEMA_NATIONAL_FLOOD_INSURANCE_PROGRAM_CLAIM_INDEX where FLOOD_EVENT = 'Hurricane Irma' and DATE_OF_LOSS between 2017-09-09 and 2017-09-12. All states: the claims data has no county or state column, so this is not a Miami-Dade figure.

facts.label: Federal hurricane declarations (major disaster + emergency) covering Miami-Dade since 1965
facts.source: FEMA disaster declarations via Snowflake Public Data
facts.note: Distinct DISASTER_ID in FEMA_DISASTER_DECLARATION_INDEX where DISASTER_TYPE = 'Hurricane', joined to FEMA_DISASTER_DECLARATION_AREAS_INDEX with COUNTY_GEO_ID = 'geoId/12086' (Miami-Dade, formerly Dade). DR and EM declarations for the same storm count separately.
